title: malva thuringiaca subsp. ambigua
intro: Malva thuringiaca subsp. ambigua, commonly known as marsh mallow, is a plant species in the mallow family. It is used to make a soothing and protective mucilage, which can be used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Malva thuringiaca subsp. ambigua include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to form a protective barrier in the gut, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activities due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages.
